text_layer_corruption.summary: Digits ARE corrupted in the extracted text layer, not just letters — confirmed both in running headers and in body/prose text. This means the text layer is unsafe for ANY content decision on this document, including numeric routing heuristics, not merely for headings.

quoted_examples.note: Consistent Caesar-shift-by-one corruption (each byte value decremented by 1: 'C'(0x43)->'&'(0x26 is not exactly -1, but the mapping is a broken/incomplete ToUnicode CMap, not a simple shift — verified purely from the visual mismatch). Digits 2,0,2,4,2,0,2,5 all render as control characters \x15/\x13/\x17/\x18, i.e. digits are corrupted identically to letters in the same string.

quoted_examples.get_text_snippet: I-2. Student to Faculty Ratio | Report the Fall 202\x17 rat[io of full-time equivalent students...]
quoted_examples.what_it_actually_says_in_image: Report the Fall 2024 ratio of full-time equivalent students...
quoted_examples.note: This is BODY PROSE TEXT, not a running header — proves the corruption is not confined to the repeated header/footer template but occurs inline within ordinary sentence content wherever a digit appears. Only the final digit of '2024' was corrupted in this extraction (the '4'), showing the corruption is character-level and can affect a subset of digits within a single number, which is especially dangerous for silent-but-wrong extraction (a partially-corrupted number still looks numeric).

quoted_examples.get_text_snippet: 1RQ\x10QHHG\x10EDVHG\x03 VHOI\x10KHOS\x03 DLG\x1d\x03 /RDQV\x03 DQG\x03 MREV\x03 IUR[m institutional, state, or other sources...]
quoted_examples.what_it_actually_says_in_image: Non-need-based self-help aid: Loans and jobs from institutional, state, or other sources...
quoted_examples.note: An entire page's running text is corrupted this way (letters AND punctuation, e.g. ':' -> '\x1d'), even though no digits happen to appear in this particular sentence — included to show the corruption is pervasive across the whole page body, not isolated to headers or occasional numbers.

text_layer_corruption.conclusion: Both routing logic (deciding which extraction path to use per page) and any text-based value extraction (e.g., regex-pulling a percentage or dollar figure straight from get_text()) are compromised on this document. Digits inside ordinary sentences and inside table-adjacent prose are corrupted exactly like surrounding letters. Image-based (vision) extraction at 150 DPI is mandatory for pages 26-50, with no text-layer fallback for any field, including ones that look like they should be 'just a number'.
